Meet the founder

About Derek Ozen.

CEO & Founder — Nifty Marketing Australia

Derek Ozen is the founder and driving force behind Nifty Marketing Australia.

He’s not a “front of camera” influencer or a professional presenter – he’s a builder. A backend operator who lives inside systems, data, and strategy, helping serious business owners create real, compounding growth.

With 25+ years of hands-on experience, Derek has been building digital systems since the early 1990s, back when innovation meant creating something from almost nothing. He started with code and problem-solving, then layered on marketing, psychology, and commercial strategy to understand what truly makes a business move.

Before launching Nifty, Derek worked in radio and television, which taught him how powerful clear communication really is. By 2006, he was deeply involved in advertising and digital marketing, helping scale brands from local start-ups to national and global enterprises, including names like Acer Australia, Cisco, and Darley Aluminium.

How Derek built the playbook

Built through study, trial, error – and algorithms.

Derek’s approach wasn’t learnt from a single course or “plug-and-play” system. He developed his processes through:

A strong foundation in mathematics and logic

Ongoing self-education and study

Years of industrial experience, trial and error, and refinement

Building and tuning algorithms, frameworks, and checklists until they consistently work

Every strategy, funnel, and campaign structure at Nifty Marketing has been tested, broken, rebuilt, and improved in the real world. Derek treats marketing like engineering – if it can’t be reverse-engineered, measured, and improved, it doesn’t go into the Nifty playbook.

Leadership

Leading a 30+ person team – still “on the tools”.

Today, Derek leads a team of 30+ specialists across SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, web development, content, AI, and strategy.

SEOGoogle AdsMeta AdsWeb developmentContentAIStrategy

But he hasn’t stepped back into a “just the CEO” role.

He is still:

  • On the tools daily – inside dashboards, CRMs, and code
  • Reviewing technical builds, tracking setups, and automation flows
  • Mentoring the team on systems thinking, performance, and long-term growth

Clients don’t just get an agency logo – they get a team backed by a founder who understands every layer of the work and still gets his hands dirty to make sure things are built properly.

Hands-on, backend-first leadership

Derek is a hands-on marketer, developer, and problem solver.

He focuses on:

Campaign architecture and tracking at a structural level
Automation workflows and CRM systems that support scale
SEO, AI, and performance frameworks that align strategy with execution

He’s far more interested in dashboards, data, and backend logic than social media appearances. You won’t see him chasing likes – he’s focused on results, momentum, and accountability for serious business owners.

Derek’s philosophy

Built to work beyond launch.

Derek believes a website should do more than look good on launch day.

His philosophy is simple:

“A great website should make it easier for customers to choose you—and easier for your business to grow.”

— Derek Ozen, CEO & Founder

Nifty Websites Australia builds websites for business owners who want a clear message, a smooth customer experience, and a solid foundation for marketing. That means understanding what the business needs before designing a page, then making sure the finished site is fast, easy to use, and built to turn interest into enquiries.

For Derek, going live is a milestone. The real measure is what the website helps your business achieve after that.

How it works

How a project works with us.

Discovery

We learn your business, your customers and the searches that matter, then agree the goals for the site.

Design for approval

Build and free SEO

Launch and support

Common questions

About Nifty, answered.

Who are Nifty Websites Australia?

Nifty Websites Australia is an Australian web design agency that builds strategic websites for small and growing businesses. We combine conversion-focused design with a complete SEO build on every site, so clients get websites that are found on Google and turn visitors into enquiries.

Who is the founder of Nifty?

Derek Ozen is the founder and driving force behind Nifty Marketing Australia. With 25+ years of hands-on experience, Derek has been building digital systems since the early 1990s. Today, Derek leads a team of 30+ specialists across SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, web development, content, AI, and strategy.

How long have you been building websites?

We are an Australian-owned team with over 25 years of combined web experience, building and optimising websites for businesses across the country.

What makes Nifty different?

We build design and SEO together, include a complete SEO build on every site, quote a fixed price before we start, and back it with Australian support. You get a site that is made to rank and convert, not just to look good.

Do you only work with businesses in one city?

No. We are an Australian team working with businesses Australia-wide, remotely and efficiently, with local web design pages for cities and towns across the country.
